description: Find a ready-made task (a 'recipe') on a website that Wield can run for the user, e.g. 'train connections Berlin to Munich', 'doctor appointment', 'second-hand sofa listings', 'Wohnung mieten'. German or English. Returns the best matches with their params_schema. Then call `run` with the chosen recipe_id and params that match params_schema. If nothing fits, offer the user to call `request_recipe`.

site.description: Optional site name or domain to restrict the search, e.g. 'bahn.de' or 'Doctolib'

task.description: What the user wants to do, in their words (German or English)

name: find_recipe
title: Find a recipe
